title: Highest temperature in London on August 3?

eventMetadata.context_description: Traders assign the highest probability to a 33°C peak in Panama City on August 3, with 32°C and 34°C nearly as likely, reflecting tight model spread in short-range tropical forecasts. Afternoon highs depend on the balance between solar heating and convective cloud cover fueled by Caribbean moisture and local sea-breeze convergence, typical of Panama’s wet season. Minor differences among these thresholds arise from the exact timing and coverage of showers, which can reduce maximum temperatures by 1–2°C. Fresh runs from the GFS and ECMWF, plus local observations, will clarify whether instability builds earlier or later, sharpening the market’s assessment of peak readings before resolution.
